text: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: After learning this program, students can deal with related complicated engineering problems individually. Students are trained to obtain the ability to solve complex environmental engineering problems, especially in the field of mining and metallurgy industry, such as sewage treatment, air pollution control, solid waste recycling and other aspects of engineering problems. ​ 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: Please be noted that the listed courses may change according to adjustment every year. Chinese, Overview of China, Microbiology for Environmental Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Water Pollution Control Engineering, Air Pollution Control Engineering, Solid Waste Treatment And Disposal, Environmental Planning and Management, Environmental Monitoring. 3. Introduction of University of Science and Technology Beijing Editor Notes: As a university of "firsts", USTB continually strives to be a leading innovator in both China and the global community. The University of Science and Technology Beijing (USTB) was founded in 1952 following the amalgamation of the best departments in related fields of five eminent universities as a result of a nationwide reorganization of the higher education system. USTB values greatly and will forever cherish its long tradition of being "Rigorous in Learning and Research and Venerating Practice". Over 100,000 graduates are contributing to society all over the world; most of them have become professionals and joined our national elites in the field of politics, economics, science and education. As metallurgy and materials science are the two disciplines for which it is most renowned, USTB is also known as "the cradle of iron and steel engineers". Learn More>> 4. About International Student Center Editor Notes: International Student Center are responsible for all international students' affairs. USTB International Student Center, which takes charge of making overall plan in development of international student education, management and coordination in students affairs, has four divisions: integrated office, office of recruitment and programs, office of students affairs, and foreign language teaching center. In July 2013, USTB has been approved by the Ministry of Education to be one of the first "Demonstration Base of Studying in China". Every year, the International Student Center will provide a rich variety of colorful internship and extra-curriculum activities for international students. They have the chance to pay a visit to industrial and commercial enterprises, to the scenery spots such as Forbidden City and the Great Wall; they can also participate in singing, dancing, painting, calligraphy competitions, "Star of Chinese" competition, Chinese debate competitions, as well as sport competitions and New Year parties. 5.
